title: Specify writing-task verification by extending the existing benchmark method
body:
## Goal
Extend the existing benchmark method with explicit artifact creation and modification tasks, as required by the writing section of the goal. Expected gain: a reviewable writing-method specification with independently established expected results, repeatable controls and visible runtime/version gaps. Use the bounded unsuccessful POC delivery as evidence of limits, not an editing implementation or oracle. No session can run LabVIEW. Do not implement product code, a writer, an evaluator or a benchmark runner.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Add benchmark/writing/README.md and method.json, extending and linking the existing protocol and change-case specifications rather than replacing the benchmark. Record exactly which current requirements already cover writing and which need new requirements.
- [ ] Define concrete creation and modification task specifications with preconditions, original/source anchors, requested changes, independent oracle provenance, expected semantic results, preservation checks for unrelated content and save version, and explicit unavailable-runtime outcomes. Cover source/rebuild handling for compiled artifacts and keep uncovered families/versions visible. Public fixtures are development only, never withheld or model-unseen evidence.
- [ ] Separate artifact fidelity, agent answers/source support and native execution; include rejecting controls for no-op edits, unintended edits, wrong behavior, version drift and unsupported artifacts. Do not treat syntactic parsing, changed bytes or owner silence as success.
- [ ] Specify paired with-tool/without-tool writing comparisons using the existing baseline contract: identical requested changes, originals, allowed inputs and total budgets, fresh sessions, frozen expected results and repetitions, and explicit accounting of output artifacts and failed/unexecuted attempts. Keep editing without LabVIEW separate from native validation.
- [ ] Include benchmark/writing/verify_method.py and a compact verification record checking specification consistency, positive controls and meaningful negative controls with asserted rejection reasons using committed synthetic inputs only. The checker must write no files and need neither LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT nor session files. Passing means design consistency, never a native run or benchmark readiness.
- [ ] Preserve previously pinned protocol, preparation-index/status and reviewed evidence bytes; write new files under benchmark/writing/ only. List exact baseline commit/tree and output hashes in the report so a later independent reviewer can inspect pinned inputs. Identify the next independent review and remaining owner/resource decisions; do not seek method acceptance in this task.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/verify_method.py
## Context
- goal/goal.md: writing extends the existing benchmark and requires independent method acceptance before product writing implementation.
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and docs/perpetua/roles.md: authoritative readiness and review sequence; no readiness approval follows from specification files.
- docs/research/poc/delivery.md: bounded unsuccessful POC delivered; semantic editing, save-version preservation and runtime validation remain unestablished.
- benchmark/preparation-status.json: current preparation consists of scoped reviewed designs with zero native execution; existing change cases provide extension points.
## Budget
Read goal/goal.md writing section; docs/perpetua/evaluation.md; docs/perpetua/roles.md; benchmark/protocol.md; benchmark/preparation-status.json; benchmark/change-cases/README.md, typedef-impact.spec.json and diagram-difference.spec.json; benchmark/baseline/runner-contract.md; benchmark/precision/README.md; docs/research/poc/delivery.md. Read only relevant sections of large files, never whole large JSON or broad repository inventories. Limit additional exploration to at most six directly linked files; stop researching and produce the bounded specification. Do not repeat global gap maps #282/#330/#400, corpus research or POC reverse engineering. Report unavailable inputs explicitly. Parent commits; no git commit.
